item.title: Was there ever a full DeLorean typeface to fill out its bizarre logotype?
item.description: Anyone know if a full typeface exists for the DeLorean logotype here? I never realized until this weekend how much character it has. It makes me feel like I’m eating hard candy in the 70s.
